notes: `הַנִּמְצְאִים` is split under rule 41: *that* to the attributive article, *were present* to the participle with its supplied copula (rule 20).
The supplied subject pronoun of `כַלּוֹת` belongs to the infinitive under rules 48 and 52, while the temporal `כְּ` takes the *when*; the light-verb rendering heads on *end* (rule 44).
s013 is the preposition `אֵת` *with* (H854), not the object marker H853.
